### Bible Pathways 05/13/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-13-or-2002-1133428.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 7:40
Points:
- Detailed biblical records show that God regards people individually rather than as an anonymous mass.
- The ancestral lists reveal contrasting legacies between faithful servants and those who forfeited their calling.
- Just as in ancient Israel, God personally knows each of His followers by name today.
- Every person will ultimately be evaluated based on their loyalty and service to the Lord.
